## Problem and change

Explain the reader's problem, what changes, and which sources support it.

## Verification

- [ ] I worked through the review checklist in `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] The change is Markdown only, and every relative link I added or changed opens the right file.
- [ ] I checked the rendered pages and navigation affected by this change.
- [ ] I preserved attribution and the applicable collection licenses.
- [ ] I confirmed that all added material is suitable for public release.

State any factual checks you performed, evidence limits, or checks you could not run. Change review dates only when facts were actually rechecked.
